steps.subject: Welcome to Ironline, {{ first_name }}
steps.body: Hi {{ first_name }}, welcome in. Your membership is active and you can book any class on the schedule. If you want a hand picking your first one, just reply.

steps.subject: Booked your first class yet?
steps.body: Hi {{ first_name }}, most new members start with Barbell Club or Mobility. Both are beginner-friendly and Coach Ray runs them.
